+#!/bin/zsh
+# 从合集视频提取硬字幕 → analysis/transcript/<part>.raw.tsv
+# 用法: tools/extract_subs.sh P1 [P2 ...]
+set -e
+ROOT=${0:A:h:h}
+for part in "$@"; do
+  frames="$ROOT/.cache/subframes/$part"
+  out="$ROOT/analysis/transcript/$part.raw.tsv"
+  [[ -f "$out" ]] && { echo "skip $part"; continue; }
+  rm -rf "$frames" && mkdir -p "$frames"
+  echo "[$part] extracting frames $(date +%T)"
+  ffmpeg -v error -i "$ROOT/source/video/$part.mp4" -vf "fps=2,crop=732:70:60:402" -start_number 0 -y "$frames/%07d.png"
+  echo "[$part] ocr $(date +%T)"
+  "$ROOT/tools/subocr" "$frames" 2 "$out"
+  rm -rf "$frames"
+  echo "[$part] done $(date +%T)"
+done
